notes: One spine: PLD PCO film -> quench-in delta sweep -> defect concentration and argued tripole ordering -> prefactor rise outweighs Em rise (tradeoff) -> vacancy mobility rises with delta -> hysteretic crossbar I-V -> conclusion. Audits: o8 (Raman association signal strongest in the most reduced film, against the F7 tripole argument), o19 (text-silent '>0.05' series in F6a breaks the monotonic mobility trend), d2 (authors' own open question). F3a crop cue is FTIR and OCR letter 'e': Raman nodes cite F3 with panel_ids []. Packet inconsistencies: F5c is the 0.032 sample (caption, and points match F6a) while linked text calls it as-prepared; F5c/F6 captions say 50-700 C (50-100 C); caption vs text intercept 47.5 vs 41.5 and slope 2.75e-7 vs 2.15e-7; text quotes sigma_e values that equal the plotted sigma_e*T; F3a arrows 534/570 cm-1 vs ~550/~600 in F3c and text; Raman delta range (0.035-0.042) is a separate sample from the mobility series (0.032-0.042); '>0.05' series in F4b, F6a, F6c is never explained in captions or linked text.
